steps.subject: sky
steps.action: cover top with Indian yellow glow
steps.rule: transparent color suits the glow effect

steps.subject: sky
steps.motion: dab and blend in the corner
steps.rule: suggests sun shining through the top corner

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: blend a bright glow outward from the corner
steps.load: cadmium yellow with a little white
steps.rule: trees should nearly vanish into the bright light

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: add titanium white to the hot spot
steps.motion: blend and pat the hot spot
steps.rule: the brightest spot is the light source

steps.subject: snow
steps.motion: graze and drag lightly then scrub
steps.rule: lets the brown underneath break through

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint bare winter trees in heavy brown
steps.motion: pull down then push edges out
steps.rule: wants rough trees with character not smooth ones

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: rub in small bushes far back
steps.rule: gives small animals a place to hide

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add more snow in the back area

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add gnarled arms to the big tree
steps.rule: makes the tree look old and gnarled

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight light side of trees with grey
steps.load: white with brown and a little black
steps.rule: a gray tone for the lit side

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add white snow around tree base

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add thin twigs and hanging limbs
steps.motion: pull thin lines and hanging limbs
steps.rule: keeps the branches rough and gnarly

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab more hanging limbs on the trees
steps.rule: makes the painting look like much time went into it
